revision: Cumulative R118–R139 over the Sites R117 frontend. R139: beta release gate fixes only: no Clarity session recording in app.html; manual/recurring journals refused on AR 1200 and AP 2050; companies not registered for GST/HST are not charged tax automatically and their purchase tax becomes cost; dashboard tax card shows other tax-code accounts; accepted-mail message; damaged backup returns 422; root config*.php denied. R138: tax code picker in bank posting screens (Match and Post, review panel, guided review), QST on its own GL accounts (2115/1115) with QST remittance, and editable Canadian starter tax codes for every province and territory plus GST-only on new Default-chart companies, with an Add Canadian tax codes button for existing companies. R137: user-defined tax codes (named taxes such as GST+QST or CGST+SGST, each with its own rate and sales/purchase GL accounts, one active code per province) used by invoices, bills, expenses, notes, cash-basis settlements and the bank feed; new companies start with no codes; existing companies switch on their first code. R136: PST/QST/RST rates stored and calculated exactly in thousandths of a percent (QST 9.975%), companies.pst_rate_mpct added automatically. R135: customer-invoice PST/QST/RST recorded and posted separately from GST/HST (2110 vs 2100) on create, draft edit, issue, recurring, notes and cash-basis receipts; plain-language sales tax guide at company registration and Company Details; Inventory Report renamed Product Activity with an ASPE 3031 / IAS 2 scope note; release manifests regenerated with one identity.

testStatus: R139 = R138 plus the fixes for defects confirmed by the invite-only beta release gate. The gate ran on the exact R138 ZIP: an Apache 2.4 + PHP-FPM 8.3 HTTPS test host, a fresh MariaDB, an SMTP sandbox with STARTTLS+AUTH, and synthetic companies. It was then re-run on the exact R139 ZIP. Results, evidence and the verdict are in FINAL-BETA-QA-REPORT.md in the source repository (not in this package). Host acceptance has not started; productionReady is false.

betaGateR138Baseline.detail: Exact R138 ZIP (sha256 83e05ec2…12fa9ed) on the HTTPS test host. Confirmed defects DEF-01 to DEF-07 (Clarity in app, AR/AP journals, unregistered company charged tax, dashboard card scope, mail message, damaged-backup 500, root config template). All other executed areas passed: install, email, roles, isolation, CSRF, uploads, client links, tax arithmetic, FX, remittances, restore equality, R118→R138 upgrade, 20-run UI matrix.

knownLimitations: Product Activity is not an inventory report; no stock, COGS or valuation
Draft editor infers per-line PST from the stored combined rate when the invoice has PST
Quebec companies configured before R136 hold 9.98% until the rate is re-entered as 9.975 in Company Details; invoices already issued keep their posted amounts
Automatic code by region uses the customer's Canadian province field only
Existing companies keep the legacy tax rules until their first tax code is saved
Starter tax codes use general rates and charge PST/RST in BC, MB and SK; companies not registered there must deactivate those codes
Tax codes saved before R138 keep their GL mapping (for example QST on 2110/1110) until edited
Dashboard GST/HST figure is 2100/1100 only; tax on other tax-code accounts is shown as a separate 'other tax accounts' amount
Companies not registered for GST/HST: automatic tax is off; a code chosen explicitly on a line still charges tax
Journals posted to 1200/2050 before R139 are not changed
Marketing pages (index, company) still load Microsoft Clarity; the Privacy Notice does not describe it (owner decision)
Invitation links carry the single-use token in the URL query string, so it can appear in host access logs (72-hour expiry, single use)
